raw.details:
Overview

  • Where Ideas Evolve into Impactful Innovations.
  • EXORA 2.0, organised by GDG on Campus ABESEC, brings together developers, designers, and emerging innovators for a 24-hour journey of building, mentorship, and innovation.
  • Combining an online hackathon with an offline grand finale at Thoughtworks Technologies, Gurugram, EXORA 2.0 provides participants with a platform to transform their ideas into impactful solutions, receive guidance from industry professionals, and showcase their work before an expert judging panel.
  • Whether you're a developer, designer, technology enthusiast, or aspiring entrepreneur, EXORA 2.0 is your opportunity to collaborate, experiment, solve real-world problems, and take your ideas beyond imagination.

Tracks

Participants can develop solutions under any of the following themes:

  • FinTech & Cybersecurity
  • HealthTech & Social Impact
  • Blockchain & Web3
  • Physical AI, Robotics & IoT
  • Open Innovation

Eligibility

  • Open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from colleges and universities across India.
  • Participants must register in teams of 2–4 members.
  • Cross-college and interdisciplinary teams are welcome.
  • Each participant can be part of only one team.
  • Developers, designers, and innovators from different technical backgrounds are encouraged to participate.

Judging Criteria

Projects will be evaluated based on:

  • Innovation & Creativity
  • Technical Implementation
  • Problem Relevance
  • Feasibility & Practical Application
  • User Experience & Design
  • Scalability & Potential Impact
  • Presentation & Demonstration

Rules & Guidelines

  • All project submissions must represent original ideas and work.
  • Teams must provide accurate details about their projects and implementation.
  • Participants must adhere to their registered team composition.
  • Teams are expected to actively participate in the respective online and offline phases.
  • Participants must follow the instructions and timelines communicated by the organising team.
  • Any form of plagiarism or unethical conduct may lead to disqualification.
  • The decisions of the organising team and judging panel will be final.

Why Participate?

  • Showcase your technical skills and innovative ideas on a professional platform.
  • Receive mentorship and constructive feedback from industry professionals.
  • Gain exposure to real-world problem-solving and product development.
  • Connect with developers, designers, mentors, and fellow innovators.
  • Explore opportunities to turn your ideas into impactful products.
  • Earn completion certificates, with special recognition certificates for top-performing teams.

Join Our Community

  • Stay connected for the latest announcements, important updates, and hackathon-related discussions.
  • Join the official EXORA 2.0 WhatsApp Community:
  • Click Here to Join the EXORA 2.0 Community
  • Organised by GDG on Campus ABESEC
  • In collaboration with Thoughtworks Technologies, Gurugram.

The stage is set. It's time to Unveil the Build!
